authority.scope: Begin Phase 1 as one governance-only GitHub transaction
conditions: Do not merge unless all applicable gates are green

candidate_head_resolution: Resolve the live branch or pull-request head from GitHub; a checked-in head SHA would be self-referential and must not be trusted.

concurrency.rule: While this lease is live, other threads remain read-only for the allowed paths and must not create a competing Phase-1 equilibrium integration lane.
concurrency.substantive_worker_branches: Preserved as candidate deltas; this lease does not close, merge, rewrite or discard them.

lifecycle.active_if: The named branch or its pull request is open, the lease has not expired, and the candidate is still based on the recorded main SHA.
released_if: The pull request or branch is closed
The candidate is superseded in Control Tower issue 1428
